citybus.title:
A simpler way to
meet your city’s buses
citybus.description: From finding a bus to transferring and exploring a city, CityBus brings the transit information each city needs into one place.
citybus.featuresTitle: Information for every part of the journey
citybus.featuresDescription: CityBus features follow the way people move through a city, rather than sitting in a flat list. Availability varies by city.
citybus.arrivalTitle: Find the bus you can take now
citybus.arrivalDescription: See nearby stops, arrival estimates, service status, and the live location of buses in one place.
citybus.mapDescription: Search stops and routes, then follow stops along the way, direction, first and last buses, and service intervals on the map.
citybus.transferDescription: Every CityBus app lets you choose a start and destination to see transfer points and walking segments on the map.
citybus.railDescription: In supported cities, find station locations, live arrivals, direction-based timetables, first and last trains, and station information.
citybus.travelDescription: Every CityBus app includes attraction locations, details, and directions on the map, along with city-specific events and tourism content.
citybus.favoriteTitle: Keep the information you use most
citybus.favoriteDescription: Save stops and routes, then keep notes, arrival alerts, and weather information close at hand.
citybus.citiesDescription: Every app includes essential bus information plus transfers, an attraction map, and weather, with city-specific additions such as urban rail, seat information, and events.
citybus.finalTitle:
Start moving around
your city more easily
citybus.finalDescription: CityBus keeps building the transit information each city needs, one step at a time.

movlog.title:
Today’s movement becomes
your own story.
movlog.description: From routes and places to the weather and photos, Movlog automatically captures your day and brings it together at a glance.
movlog.introKicker: Let the day pass, not the story
movlog.aboutTitle:
Without trying to log it,
your day comes together.
movlog.aboutDescription: Movlog automatically organizes movement and visits. Meet your day again through mapped routes and a chronological timeline.
movlog.trackingDescription: Movlog captures routes, distance, time, and speed while distinguishing driving from walking. Visits and parking become part of the same day.
movlog.trackingPoint1: Background recording with no extra steps
movlog.trackingPoint3: Weather and visit events in context
movlog.archiveTitle:
Find it on the calendar,
remember it in the timeline.
movlog.archiveDescription: Find any day in monthly and yearly archives, then revisit movement, visits, and photos in order. Add a note to keep the memory with it.
movlog.contextTitle:
Keep more than a location.
Remember the moment.
movlog.contextDescription: Movlog records not only where you were, but the context that helps you remember the day.
movlog.visitTitle: Where you went and how long you stayed
movlog.visitDescription: Movlog detects visits and dwell time automatically, connecting them to the flow of your day.
movlog.weatherDescription: See the weather from your trip and around your current location alongside your log.
movlog.photoTitle: Turn photos into memories on the map
movlog.photoDescription: Connect photos to visited places and rediscover them inside your movement log.
movlog.parkingTitle: Remember where you left the car
movlog.parkingDescription: Movlog naturally connects driving, parking, and the visit that follows.
movlog.insightsTitle:
Find your patterns
in the story so far.
movlog.insightsDescription: Explore your farthest day, most visited places, and longest stays. Movement, visits, and photos become achievements and levels that make keeping a log more rewarding.
movlog.insightStat1Detail: The shape of your everyday radius
movlog.insightStat2Detail: New records in distance and time
movlog.insightStat3Detail: A sense of progress that grows with every log
movlog.galleryTitle:
From the start of the day to looking back,
one continuous flow.
movlog.privacyDescription: Movlog does not collect, process, or retain personal information. There is no advertising tracker—just an experience focused on recording your day.
movlog.finalKicker: TRACE YOUR PATH, TELL YOUR STORY
movlog.finalTitle:
Start with today’s movement.
Make it your story.
movlog.finalDescription: Movlog is available to download for free on the App Store.

taghere.title:
Remember the place,
and the space inside.
taghere.description: Save home, work, and places you return to. Location and Bluetooth help record visits and recognize spaces, so you can look back at where you spent time.
taghere.featureEyebrow: A PLACE HAS ITS OWN SPACES
taghere.featureTitle:
Where you were,
and what it was like.
taghere.featureLead: Save places and their spaces together to make location memories more specific.
taghere.feature1Body: Save home, work, or a favorite café from your current location or the map, then set its recognition radius.
taghere.feature2Body: Add rooms or floors within a place and connect Bluetooth devices to recognize nearby spaces.
taghere.feature3Body: Review recognized places and spaces by date, and search by their names.
taghere.galleryTitle:
Places, spaces, and visits
in one continuous record.
taghere.detailAlt: Place detail with spaces and recognition radius
taghere.galleryNote: Screens show sample places and history created to illustrate the app.
taghere.permissionsBody: Location detects entry to and exit from saved places. Bluetooth checks nearby registered devices to identify a space, and notifications can tell you when a visit record is complete. Background recognition depends on your permission settings.
taghere.finalEyebrow: REMEMBER THE PLACES YOU RETURN TO
taghere.finalTitle:
Keep the places
you want to remember.

markdam.title:
Words, images, and diagrams
made comfortable to read.
markdam.description: Open Markdown documents on Mac, iPhone, and iPad, read them, and save them as PDF. View tables, code, local images, SVG, Mermaid diagrams, and equations offline.
markdam.featureTitle:
Keep the structure clear.
Make reading your own.
markdam.featureLead: Read document structure and visuals together, with reading controls and PDF export in one place.
markdam.feature1Body: Read headings, lists, quotes, tables, and code in a clear layout. Use the outline and in-document search to find a section.
markdam.feature2Body: View images stored with your document, safe SVG, Mermaid diagrams, and LaTeX equations.
markdam.feature3Body: Choose A4 or US Letter, portrait or landscape, and margins to save a multi-page PDF.
markdam.galleryTitle:
From reading to saving a PDF,
stay with the document.
markdam.readerAlt: Reading a Markdown document in Markdam
markdam.diagramAlt: A document with equations and sync notation
markdam.localTitle:
Keep the original.
Read on your device.
markdam.localBody: Markdam is a read-only viewer. It leaves the original Markdown unchanged and does not send document contents to a server. To access relative-path images, you may need to select the folder that contains the document. Remote images are not fetched automatically.
markdam.finalTitle:
Open a Markdown file.
Read and keep it.

articles.title: Article 1 (Purpose of Personal Information Processing)
articles.body: Devp-YG Applications comply with the following policy to protect the personal information of all application users in accordance with personal information protection laws.

articles.title: Article 2 (Processing and Retention Period of Personal Information)
articles.body: Devp-YG Applications do not collect, process, or retain personal information.

articles.title: Article 3 (Provision of Personal Information to Third Parties)
articles.body: Devp-YG Applications do not provide personal information to third parties.

articles.title: Article 4 (Entrustment of Personal Information Processing)
articles.body: Devp-YG Applications do not outsource the processing of personal information.

articles.title: Article 5 (Items of Personal Information Processed)
articles.body: Devp-YG Applications do not process any personal information.

articles.title: Article 6 (Destruction of Personal Information)
articles.body: As Devp-YG Applications do not process personal information, there is nothing to destroy.

articles.title: Article 7 (Measures to Ensure the Security of Personal Information)

articles.title: Article 8 (Installation, Operation, and Refusal of Automatic Collection Devices)

articles.title: Article 9 (Personal Information Protection Officer)

articles.title: Article 10 (Changes to this Privacy Policy)
articles.body: This privacy policy takes effect on the date each application is released on the App Store.

rtvideo.title:
Audio in playback,
captions you can read.
rtvideo.description: RTVideo recognizes speech from video and audio playing in another app, then translates it into your chosen language. Follow along in the app or a floating PiP caption window.
rtvideo.featureTitle:
Listen to content.
Read it in your language.
rtvideo.featureLead: Follow the original speech and translation while playing videos, online lessons, podcasts, and other audio content.
rtvideo.feature1Body: Start playback in an app that supports audio sharing and allow RTVideo to receive shared system audio. It recognizes speech and displays translated captions.
rtvideo.feature2Body: Choose speech and translation languages, then adjust whether the original appears and how large the captions are.
rtvideo.feature3Body: Follow translations in the app caption view or a PiP window. For supported combinations, captions can be separated by speaker.
rtvideo.galleryTitle:
See translated captions
and the controls at a glance.
rtvideo.originalAlt: Original speech and speaker-separated translated captions
rtvideo.galleryNote: Screens illustrate the features. Recognition and speaker separation depend on the audio and device support.
rtvideo.scopeBody: Audio is received through system audio sharing. Available language pairs depend on speech recognition and translation support on your device and operating system; language models may need to download on first use. Audio may not come through if the playback app does not support sharing or the content is protected. Captions take time to recognize and translate, and are not synchronized to playback position. In app-window mode, keep RTVideo visible alongside the playback app. In PiP mode, use the floating translation caption window.
rtvideo.finalTitle:
Follow the words in your content
one caption at a time.

markdamPrivacy.title: Privacy Policy
content: Article 1. Purposes of Processing Personal Information
When users consent to app analytics, the app processes usage information through Firebase Analytics, provided by Google LLC, for the following purposes:

• Identifying app installations, launches, and usage
  • Analyzing feature usage and improving usability
  • Analyzing errors and improving app stability
App analytics information is collected and used only with the user’s consent.
Article 2. Processing and Retention Periods
The following retention periods apply to Firebase Analytics data:

CategoryRetention period
Event data2 months
User data14 months from the user’s most recent activity
The retention period for user data is recalculated whenever new activity occurs. These settings apply to user-level and event-level data, but not in the same way to standard aggregated reports.
Users manage how long documents and PDF files are kept on their device or in their selected file storage locations.
Article 3. Provision to Third Parties and Use of External Services
The operator does not provide personal information to third parties for their independent use. App analytics entrusted to Google LLC is described in Article 4.
App version checks
To check for the latest version, the app sends its bundle ID to Apple’s App Store lookup service.
Markdam also sends the Store country code based on the device’s region settings so the lookup matches that region. Document contents and file information are not included in this request.
Apple may process network connection information when handling service requests. See Apple’s Privacy Policy for details.
Storage and sharing selected by the user

When users select an external storage location, such as iCloud Drive, or use the operating system’s sharing feature, files are sent to the selected service or app. The relevant service provider’s policies apply.
Article 4. Entrusted Processing and Processing Outside the Country

The app operator is the personal information controller and entrusts app usage analytics to Google LLC. The “Google products and services” data-sharing setting for Firebase Analytics (Google Analytics) is not enabled.

CategoryDetails
Personal information controllerApp operator
ProcessorGoogle LLC
Service usedFirebase Analytics (Google Analytics)
Entrusted workProcessing app usage statistics and providing analytical results
Data processedApp analytics information described in Article 5
Retention periodAs set out in Article 2
When users consent, app analytics information is sent to Google through Firebase Analytics. Google uses global infrastructure, so analytics information is processed and stored outside the country.
For details about Google’s data processing and safeguards, see Google Analytics data protection and Google’s information about international data transfers.
Article 5. Categories of Personal Information Processed
The app does not collect information that directly identifies users, such as names, email addresses, telephone numbers, or member account details, for app analytics.
When users consent to app analytics, the following information is processed:

CategoryData processed
IdentifiersFirebase app instance identifier, which distinguishes app installations, and iOS Identifier for Vendor (IDFV)
App and device informationTechnical information such as app version, operating system version, and device model
Usage and diagnostic informationApp launch, screen, and feature usage events; document opening source and file format; ranges for document word and heading counts and whether rendering warnings occurred; query-length ranges and whether a search matched; predefined error types and codes
Approximate location informationCountry and regional information inferred by Google Analytics from network information
App, device, and usage information may be analyzed in association with analytics identifiers. The operator does not link users’ names or contact details to those identifiers.
Document files and contents are processed on the user’s device and are not sent to or stored on the operator’s servers.
Document contents and titles, file names and paths, and the actual text of search queries are not included in app analytics information.
Article 6. Destruction of Personal Information

Analytics data that reaches the end of its retention period is automatically deleted under Google Analytics’ scheduled deletion process. There may be a delay between the end of the retention period and deletion, depending on the service’s processing schedule.

When consent is withdrawn, collection of analytics information stops going forward. Information already sent to Google is not deleted immediately and is handled under the retention periods in Article 2 and Google Analytics’ deletion procedures.

The app does not provide a feature to access, correct, or delete individual analytics information sent to Google’s servers. That information is handled under Google Analytics’ retention period and deletion procedures. See the Google Privacy Help Center for information about privacy requests for data processed by Google.

Users manage documents and PDF files using deletion features on their devices or in their selected storage locations. Copies stored or shared with external services or other apps are subject to those services’ deletion procedures.
Article 7. Measures to Ensure the Security of Personal Information

The operator determines the purposes and categories of app analytics and configures the app to send those events to Firebase Analytics, provided by Google LLC, when users consent. The operator does not separately retain individual analytics records. Google LLC processes and stores the information it receives to provide its analytics service.
Google applies safeguards such as encryption and access controls to analytics information during transmission and storage.
Article 8. Automatic Collection and Analytics Information Management
App analytics consent

Firebase Analytics automatically collects the information described in Article 5 only with the user’s consent. Users may withdraw or renew consent at any time under Settings → Privacy in the app. Declining or withdrawing consent does not prevent use of the app’s core features.
Analytics information already sent to Google

The app does not create member accounts, and the app cannot delete individual analytics information sent to Google’s servers. After consent is withdrawn, collection stops going forward; information already sent is handled under the retention period in Article 2 and Google Analytics’ deletion procedures. For privacy requests about information processed by Google, contact the Google Privacy Help Center.
Article 9. Privacy Officer and Contact Information
The operator is responsible for the processing and protection of personal information and handles related inquiries and complaints.

• Contact: App operator
  • Email: devp.yg@gmail.com
Article 10. Effective Date and Changes to This Policy
This policy takes effect on the release date of the app version that includes the app analytics consent feature.

If the purposes or categories of processing, external services, retention periods, or consent management methods change, the changes and their effective date will be posted on this page. Previous versions will be maintained separately. Where a change requires additional consent, it will be obtained before the change takes effect.

If the purposes or categories of processing, external services, retention periods, or consent management methods change, the changes and their effective date will be posted on this page. Previous versions will be maintained separately. Where a change requires additional consent, it will be obtained before the change takes effect.

rtvideoPrivacy.title: Privacy Policy
content: Article 1. Purposes of Processing Personal Information
When users consent to app analytics, the app processes usage information through Firebase Analytics, provided by Google LLC, for the following purposes:

• Identifying app installations, launches, and usage
  • Analyzing feature usage and improving usability
  • Analyzing errors and improving app stability
App analytics information is collected and used only with the user’s consent.
Article 2. Processing and Retention Periods
The following retention periods apply to Firebase Analytics data:

CategoryRetention period
Event data2 months
User data14 months from the user’s most recent activity
The retention period for user data is recalculated whenever new activity occurs. These settings apply to user-level and event-level data, but not in the same way to standard aggregated reports.

App settings are stored in the app’s storage on the user’s device while the app remains installed. Audio, recognized captions, and translations from a session are held in memory during processing and cleared when the session ends. A speaker identification model downloaded by the user is stored in the app’s storage and is deleted through Settings or when the app is removed.
Article 3. Provision to Third Parties and Use of External Services
The operator does not provide personal information to third parties for their independent use. App analytics entrusted to Google LLC is described in Article 4.
App version checks
To check for the latest version, the app sends its bundle ID to Apple’s App Store lookup service.
RTVideo also sends the current Store country code for its App Store version lookup. Audio and caption information are not included in this request.
Apple may process network connection information when handling service requests. See Apple’s Privacy Policy for details.

Speech recognition and translation use Apple’s on-device features. Required language models may be downloaded from Apple’s servers. Apple may receive usage and performance metrics for translation, including the app bundle ID and source and target languages, but does not receive audio, recognized captions, or translated text. Apple’s Privacy Policy governs retention and deletion of these metrics and network request information; the app cannot access or delete individual records on Apple’s servers. See Apple Translation and Speech model documentation.

When users start a speaker identification model download in Settings, the app downloads model files from Hugging Face. The request may include network connection information and the requested model repository. Audio and captions are not included. Hugging Face’s policies govern retention and deletion of request information; the app cannot access or delete individual records on Hugging Face’s servers. See Hugging Face’s Privacy Policy.
Article 4. Entrusted Processing and Processing Outside the Country

The app operator is the personal information controller and entrusts app usage analytics to Google LLC. The “Google products and services” data-sharing setting for Firebase Analytics (Google Analytics) is not enabled.
The Google Analytics account currently has “Engagement modeling and business insights” enabled. Google says information used for that feature is aggregated and anonymized.

CategoryDetails
Personal information controllerApp operator
ProcessorGoogle LLC
Service usedFirebase Analytics (Google Analytics)
Entrusted workProcessing app usage statistics and providing analytical results
Data processedApp analytics information described in Article 5
Retention periodAs set out in Article 2
When users consent, app analytics information is sent to Google through Firebase Analytics. Google uses global infrastructure, so analytics information is processed and stored outside the country.
For details about Google’s data processing and safeguards, see Google Analytics data protection and Google’s information about international data transfers.
Article 5. Categories of Personal Information Processed
The app does not collect information that directly identifies users, such as names, email addresses, telephone numbers, or member account details, for app analytics.
When users consent to app analytics, the following information is processed:

CategoryData processed
IdentifiersFirebase app instance identifier, which distinguishes app installations. iOS Identifier for Vendor (IDFV) is not collected.
App and device informationTechnical information such as app version, operating system version, and device model
Usage and diagnostic informationApp launch, screen, and feature usage; settings and language selections; permission and operation outcomes; translation and model preparation results; session duration and count aggregates; predefined error types and codes
Approximate location informationCountry and regional information inferred by Google Analytics from network information
App, device, and usage information may be analyzed in association with analytics identifiers. The operator does not link users’ names or contact details to those identifiers.
Audio, recognized captions, translated text, user-entered text, file names, and paths are not included in app analytics information.
Article 6. Destruction of Personal Information

Analytics data that reaches the end of its retention period is automatically deleted under Google Analytics’ scheduled deletion process. There may be a delay between the end of the retention period and deletion, depending on the service’s processing schedule.

When consent is withdrawn, collection of analytics information stops going forward. Information already sent to Google is not deleted immediately and is handled under the retention periods in Article 2 and Google Analytics’ deletion procedures.

The app does not provide a feature to access, correct, or delete individual analytics information sent to Google’s servers. That information is handled under Google Analytics’ retention period and deletion procedures. See the Google Privacy Help Center for information about privacy requests for data processed by Google.
Removing the app also removes its settings and model files from the app’s device storage. Downloaded speaker identification models can be deleted using the model deletion feature in app Settings.
Article 7. Measures to Ensure the Security of Personal Information

The operator determines the purposes and categories of app analytics and configures the app to send those events to Firebase Analytics, provided by Google LLC, when users consent. The operator does not separately retain individual analytics records. Google LLC processes and stores the information it receives to provide its analytics service.
Google applies safeguards such as encryption and access controls to analytics information during transmission and storage.
Article 8. Automatic Collection and Analytics Information Management
App analytics consent

Firebase Analytics automatically collects the information described in Article 5 only with the user’s consent. Users may withdraw or renew consent at any time under Settings → Privacy in the app. Declining or withdrawing consent does not prevent use of the app’s core features.
Analytics information already sent to Google

The app does not create member accounts, and the app cannot delete individual analytics information sent to Google’s servers. After consent is withdrawn, collection stops going forward; information already sent is handled under the retention period in Article 2 and Google Analytics’ deletion procedures. For privacy requests about information processed by Google, contact the Google Privacy Help Center.
Article 9. Privacy Officer and Contact Information
The operator is responsible for the processing and protection of personal information and handles related inquiries and complaints.

• Contact: App operator
  • Email: devp.yg@gmail.com
Article 10. Effective Date and Changes to This Policy
This policy takes effect on the release date of the app version that includes the app analytics consent feature.

If the purposes or categories of processing, external services, retention periods, or consent management methods change, the changes and their effective date will be posted on this page. Previous versions will be maintained separately. Where a change requires additional consent, it will be obtained before the change takes effect.
